jobs.verdict: USED: the throw. It reads as crinkled waffle cotton muslin with a frayed fringe (not a knit), in the Pecan hue (54.8 deg against the SKU's 54.3). The drape is the same (from behind the lumbar, across the seat front, over the right arm; one fall down behind the Olia to the rug, one down the arm's outer side to the floor by the lamp base), but fuller: the front fall is wider (it covers more of the arm's front face and shows under the table top) and its fringe lies about 15 canvas px (11 frame px) further onto the rug; the outer fall sits a little left, off the lamp pole. The cushions, sofa, table and lamp were left alone by the model (their pixels are not used)
